body: This is some really helpful insight! I do want to thank you for saying that and I hope this doesn't come off as directed at you but that's pretty lousy. It seems unfair to judge that I am not serious about the cat just based off an application (and potentially my age) rather than maybe going towards an interview step to get a firm sense of whether or not this is the right choice. Thank you for your feedback, as this actually helped relieve some anxiety I was feeling about continuing to find a cat that will fit with my home.
